findings.description: FileUpload.bytes should be typed as Buffer, not Uint8Array, since the rest of this codebase uses Node's Buffer type for binary payloads.
Initializing result.succeeded to false before the upload is even attempted means a thrown synchronous error in this function would report succeeded: false for a file that was never attempted at all.
uploadBatch processes files strictly sequentially; a single slow upload blocks every file behind it in the batch.
